purpose: Collects the textfilterservice runtime building blocks—Text Filter Constants, Text Filter Network, Text Filter Service, Text Filter Service Client—and composes them for reuse in Roblox experiences.
description: Collects the textfilterservice runtime building blocks—Text Filter Constants, Text Filter Network, Text Filter Service, Text Filter Service Client—and composes them for reuse in Roblox experiences.

Constants/TextFilterConstants.luau.description: Text Filter Constants provides the class/model implementation used by the Textfilterservice package.

Constants/TextFilterNetwork.luau.description: Text Filter Network provides the network implementation used by the Textfilterservice package.

TextFilterService.luau.description: Text Filter Service provides the service implementation used by the Textfilterservice package. Public entry points include `TextFilterService.Init`, `TextFilterService.Start`, `TextFilterService.PromiseNonChatStringForUser`, `TextFilterService.PromiseNonChatStringForBroadcast`, `TextFilterService.PromisePreviewNonChatStringForBroadcast`.

TextFilterServiceClient.luau.description: Text Filter Service Client provides the service implementation used by the Textfilterservice package. Public entry points include `TextFilterServiceClient.Init`, `TextFilterServiceClient.PromiseFilteredTextFromLocalPlayer`, `TextFilterServiceClient.PromiseNonChatStringForUser`, `TextFilterServiceClient.PromiseNonChatStringForBroadcast`, `TextFilterServiceClient.PromisePreviewNonChatStringForBroadcast`.
